synopses.1: Bento Santiago's first-person account of his youth, his childhood love for Capitu and his doubts about marital fidelity.
synopses.2: A revolutionary work narrated by a deceased author, introducing realism in Brazil with irony and psychological genius.
synopses.3: A masterpiece of Brazilian naturalism depicting collective life, social tensions and everyday life in a Rio tenement house.
synopses.4: The story of Dr. Simão Bacamarte and his asylum in Itaguaí — a timeless satire on the limits of sanity, science and power.
synopses.5: The tragicomic portrait of an idealistic patriot who proposes tupi-guarani as Brazil's official language and faces the country's contradictions.
synopses.6: A collection bringing together The Slave Ship and other famous poems by Castro Alves, the peak of Brazilian lyric and abolitionist poetry.
synopses.7: The legend of Ceará and the founding romance between the honey-lipped virgin and the white warrior Martim.
synopses.8: The epic indianist novel portraying the love and loyalty of Peri and Cecília in the forests of colonial Brazil.
synopses.9: A structured, practical guide to studying and mastering Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Prompt Engineering.
synopses.10: A comprehensive collection of study maps for computing professionals and students to navigate their learning journeys with clarity.
synopses.11: A training manual on DevOps culture, Linux system administration, automation and server orchestration for modern infrastructure.
synopses.12: A guide with structured learning paths, proficiency levels and technologies for professional development.
synopses.13: Open collaborative learning paths in Portuguese for developer training and technical interview preparation.
synopses.14: Step-by-step mind maps and guides covering software architecture, DevOps, security and programming stacks.
synopses.15: Robert C. Martin's practical guidelines on universal software architecture rules, architectural boundaries, testing and framework decoupling.
synopses.16: Martin Fowler's classic demonstrating the refactoring catalogue, principles of readable code, code smells and automated testing.
synopses.17: A visual, didactic guide covering the 22 classic design patterns (creational, structural and behavioural) with diagrams and real-world analogies.
synopses.18: The Lean Startup methodology: the Build-Mean-Learn loop, minimum viable product (MVP), hypothesis testing and pivoting for digital products.
synopses.19: A manual on front-end development focused on mobile devices: media queries, viewport, image optimization and touch navigation.
synopses.20: Habits proven by technical leaders for focus, continuous learning, eliminating distractions and building high-impact projects.
synopses.21: Core concepts of Big Data, Hadoop, Spark, NoSQL and data architectures to support strategic decision making.
synopses.22: A step-by-step guide to dimensional modeling (Kimball), open-source ETL and building efficient management dashboards without high licensing costs.
synopses.23: Aurélio Marinho's classic guide teaching regex with humor, clarity and examples applicable to Python, JavaScript, Linux and code editors.
synopses.24: Central concepts of data science: regression, classification, decision trees and practical visualization in Python and R.
synopses.25: The OAuth 2.0 and JWT standards for secure access control of microservices and web applications with Java and Spring.
synopses.26: Leadership and management lessons from Netflix: removing bureaucratic controls, honest feedback and attracting the best talent.
synopses.27: A practical guide to building electronic and Internet of Things (IoT) projects with the open hardware Arduino platform.
synopses.28: Building real-time interactive applications using Node.js, Express, Socket.io and document-oriented databases.
synopses.29: A practical manual for configuring DNS, DHCP, Apache/Nginx web servers, SSH, iptables and network management on Linux distributions.
synopses.30: An introductory text on the mathematical foundations of quantum mechanics applied to information processing and quantum cryptography.
synopses.31: An open, collaborative learning path gathering the best free resources in Portuguese for training modern frontend developers.
synopses.32: An open path covering backend languages (Node, Python, Java, Go), data modeling, messaging and security for production services.
synopses.33: A structured path in Portuguese to master DevOps culture, deploy automation, containers and infrastructure as code.
synopses.34: A training roadmap for data engineers with open resources covering ingestion, distributed processing and data governance.
synopses.35: A complete path in Portuguese for software quality, manual and automated testing, best practices and CI/CD with a focus on QA.
